title: job-3
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Primary request: A refined hand-drawn editorial illustration of an AI agent runtime cost control room. A human engineer and a small thoughtful robot monitor a central system made of several pipes and circuit branches. Each branch has a clear analog meter, a valve, a circuit breaker, a boundary gate and a small ownership tag shape with no text. The system conveys attribution, bounded retries, parent-child budgets, single representation and observability through visual objects rather than labels. Calm, precise and optimistic, with lots of breathing room.
Style/medium: hand-drawn engineering notebook, graphite and ink line art, subtle watercolor, warm editorial sketch
Composition/framing: landscape isometric-ish control room, central meter panel, branching pipes and circuit breakers, balanced negative space
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse daylight, delicate paper texture, no heavy shadows
Color palette: warm off-white, graphite gray, terracotta orange, sage green, muted blue
Constraints: no readable text, no letters, no logos, no watermark, elegant and technically credible
Avoid: photorealism, dark background, neon cyberpunk, glossy 3D, childish cartoon, dense labels
